articles.text: General Mills, ADM, Walmart Partner to Accelerate Regenerative Agriculture Across 40,000 Midwest Wheat Acres. MINNEAPOLIS, CHICAGO & BENTONVILLE, Ark., July 15, 2026--General Mills, ADM and Walmart today announced a strategic collaboration to accelerate regenerative agriculture across 40,000 Midwest wheat acres.

articles.text: General Mills and Box Tops for Education Reunite "Saved by the Bell" Cast to Celebrate 30 Years of Giving Back to Schools. MINNEAPOLIS, July 14, 2026--Box Tops for Education is heading back to Bayside High with the cast of "Saved by the Bell" to celebrate 30 years and nearly $1 billion raised for schools nationwide. General Mills, in partnership with Universal Products & Experiences, is reuniting the iconic cast for Saved by the Box Tops, a feel-good back-to-school campaign inspired by the beloved television series and the everyday impact of Box Tops for Education.

articles.text: General Mills plans supply chain revamp as part of $3B cost-cutting effort. The upgrade is critical because the consumer packaged goods company’s current network was built for a lower-volume era, executives said.
